record.question: Which of the following statements about the All-India Services is correct?
options: The All-India Services may be created by an Act of Parliament.
The endorsement of the Rajya Sabha is not essential for the creation of the All-India Services.
The rules of recruitment to the All-India Services are determined by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC).
The conditions of service to the All-India Services may be altered by the UPSC
record.explanation: All-India Services may be created by an Act of Parliament.
